full_prompt_en: A restrained, finely drawn illustration shows a young woman with a teal handbag beneath a pale leafy tree, surrounded by dark flying birds on an ivory background. The tree fills the upper half with a dense network of thin grey branches and muted blue-green leaves, while its slender trunk descends behind the woman toward the lower right. Loose leaf shapes and faint grey marks drift into the open space below the canopy. Slightly right of centre, the woman stands with her body turned left and her face lifted toward the upper left. Her dark brown hair forms a short, softly waved bob tucked around the ears, and her pale face has a small straight nose, rosy cheeks and closed coral lips. She wears an ivory blouse patterned with sparse coral floral marks, its sleeves gathered near the elbows, and a high-waisted coral skirt with long simple pleats. The skirt continues beyond the lower edge, leaving her feet outside the frame. Both bare forearms angle downward, and her hands meet around the brown handles of a structured blue-green handbag resting low in front of her left side. The bag has rounded corners, dark piping and a small front pocket. At the bottom left, a black cat lies with its head raised and its eyes facing the viewer, its tail extending toward the bag. A flock of charcoal birds crosses the scene at different heights: larger spread-wing silhouettes appear near the top and sides, while smaller distant shapes pass among the branches and beside the woman's torso. Soft, nearly even illumination leaves only gentle shading on the face, sleeves and bag, preserving broad flat areas of colour. The overall composition balances a narrow coral figure and dark scattered silhouettes against airy ivory space and a delicate sage canopy, creating a calm, lightly whimsical scene.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅克制的细线插画表现一位提青绿手袋的年轻女子站在浅色叶树下，象牙白背景中飞着深色鸟。树木上半部由密集细灰枝条和暗蓝绿叶片构成，纤细树干从女子身后向右下延伸。零散叶形与浅灰痕迹散入树冠下方留白。女子略偏中央右侧站立，身体朝左，脸抬向左上方。深棕短发轻轻起伏，沿耳边拢成波波头；浅色面容有小直鼻、玫瑰色面颊和闭合的珊瑚色嘴唇。她穿象牙白衬衣，稀疏珊瑚色小花纹点缀其上，衣袖在肘边聚拢；高腰珊瑚色裙子带有长而简练的褶线，裙摆延伸出下边缘，双脚在画外。两条裸露前臂向下斜伸，双手会合在棕色包柄附近，造型规整的蓝绿手袋低低置于身体左前方。包的转角圆润，带深色包边和小前袋。左下方黑猫卧着，抬起头，双眼朝向观者，尾巴伸向手袋。成群炭灰鸟在不同高度掠过，上方和两侧是较大的展翅剪影，较小远处鸟形穿过枝条或位于女子躯干旁。柔和、近乎均匀的光线只在面部、袖子和手袋上留下温和明暗，保留宽阔平坦色区。整体构图让狭长珊瑚色人物和零散深色剪影与轻盈象牙白留白、纤细鼠尾草色树冠形成平衡，呈现安静而略带奇趣的场景。
style_prompt_en: The digital illustration uses pale, low-contrast fields, clean contours, and sparse linear ornament. Sage gray, cool off-white, muted coral, charcoal, and blue-green form a restrained palette, with a few dark accents punctuating the open ground. Shapes remain flat and simplified, while delicate branching lines and small repeated marks add decorative rhythm. The composition places a narrow vertical mass slightly off center, balanced by broad negative space and scattered dark accents. Even illumination keeps shadows minimal and preserves the airy, graphic quality. The mood is poised, quiet, and gently whimsical.
style_prompt_zh: 数字插画采用浅淡、低反差色域、清晰轮廓和稀疏线性装饰。鼠尾草灰、冷调灰白、低饱和珊瑚色、炭灰与蓝绿色构成克制色盘，少量深色强调点散落在开阔底色上。形体保持平面化与简化，纤细枝状线条和小型重复笔触增添装饰节奏。构图将狭长纵向形体略微偏置，以宽阔留白和零散深色强调点取得平衡。均匀照明使阴影很少，并保留轻盈图形质感。整体气氛端庄、安静而略带奇趣。
theme_en: A woman with a teal handbag stands beneath a pale leafy tree among flying dark birds, with a black cat beside her
theme_zh: 女子提青绿色手袋站在浅色叶树下，周围飞着深色鸟，身旁卧着黑猫
name: Harriet Lee-Merrion
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
